sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for sharing the cost context and for your continued support; we value our long-standing relationship. The volume figure below is our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you, and our demand forecast is rising; the longer contract term also offers planning security. We understand your focus on larger-volume customers and that price reductions are not currently possible; would you be willing to walk us through your calculation, as your owner once offered?

We confirm a binding volume of 20000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 4.39 (po:4500014467-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014329-10).
In our call of 2026-06-16 (doc:20260616-70620-M6) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Likewise, we checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. 

Regarding your request for a cost calculation, our initial offer already outlined the specific indices that form the basis of our pricing. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

We are glad to work with you and are willing to accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, which brings our offer to a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for reviewing the information we shared and for moving your offer; we appreciate the flexibility on the contract term and payment terms. We understand that the cited history does not alter your calculation and that you cannot provide further cost detail; we appreciate your transparency on the indices and material share. Our full demand for this part over the term is placed with you, and the longer contract provides planning security as our forecast is rising; our proposal moves toward you again.

Your on-time delivery was 85.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.82 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 20000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
